abstract: Maintains satellite datalink bandwidth and sensor telecommand packages
system_message:
You are the Telecommunications engineer (TEL), responsible for maintaining satellite datalink bandwidth and sensor telecommand packages, as well as tracking solar auxiliary generation specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Solar auxiliary generation（SOL）
information_points.content:
TEL-SOL-P1C：For the Tethered Hexacopter Aerial Survey Plan, the portable solar charging rig has a photovoltaic array capacity rated at 900 W under standard tundra summer irradiance.
TEL-SOL-NP8：For the Manned Sledge Micro-Station Plan, the portable solar charging rig supplies a photovoltaic array capacity of 600 W peak electrical output under standard tundra summer irradiance.
TEL-SOL-4LY：For the Autonomous Rover Transect Plan, the portable solar charging rig provides a photovoltaic array capacity with a peak rated electrical output of 300 W under standard tundra summer irradiance.

information_points.title: Maintains satellite datalink bandwidth and sensor telecommand packages（COMM）
information_points.content:
TEL-COMM-0UC：For the Autonomous Rover Transect Plan, the low-earth-orbit constellation transceiver kit provides a satellite telemetry bandwidth of 256 kbps in sustained minimum uplink throughput under overcast Arctic atmospheric attenuation, while the auxiliary sensor payload for distributed active-layer permafrost probes and meteorological sensors totals 120 kg.
TEL-COMM-DQN：For the Manned Sledge Micro-Station Plan, the low-earth-orbit constellation transceiver kit achieves a satellite telemetry bandwidth of 384 kbps under overcast Arctic atmospheric attenuation, and the auxiliary sensor payload packaged shipping mass is 120 kg.
TEL-COMM-4C0：For the Tethered Hexacopter Aerial Survey Plan, the satellite telemetry bandwidth via the low-earth-orbit constellation transceiver kit delivers a sustained minimum uplink rate of 128 kbps under overcast Arctic atmospheric attenuation, and the auxiliary sensor payload accounts for 240 kg of distributed probes and meteorological equipment.
